headline: Vessel restarts lift revenue and EBITDA sharply
summary_short: Prosafe SE's Q2 2026 revenue was $46.5M, up 50.5% y/y, with EBITDA of $9.7M more than tripling y/y from $3.1M; H1 2026 revenue reached $94.6M (+48.0% y/y) as the company raised full-year EBITDA guidance to $50-55M.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue was $46.5M (+50.5% y/y from $30.9M); H1 2026 revenue $94.6M (+48.0% y/y from $63.9M). Q2 EBITDA of $9.7M more than tripled y/y from $3.1M; H1 EBITDA $24.5M vs $7.7M. Fleet utilization was 71% in Q2 as four of five vessels generated revenue — Safe Eurus and Safe Boreas on hire the full period, Safe Zephyrus and Safe Notos resuming after completing scheduled five-year surveys in April, while Safe Caledonia stayed in lay-up. Backlog stood at $407M including options. Full-year 2026 EBITDA guidance was raised to the high end of the previously communicated range, now $50-55M. Q2 standalone EPS of NOK -0.02 narrowed sharply from NOK -1.34 a year earlier.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. One WebSearch located the company's own GlobeNewswire release (whitelisted wire service) directly. Direct WebFetch of globenewswire.com timed out and WebFetch of prosafe.com returned HTTP 403; a WebFetch of the same release syndicated via Manila Times (non-aggregator news outlet carrying the GlobeNewswire feed verbatim) succeeded and supplied all figures used here. Q2 EPS q/q delta is 'n/m' (not meaningful) since the prior quarter's shard value was exactly 0. EPS rows are the Q2-standalone actuals from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and are not on the same basis as the USD revenue/EBITDA figures from the release.

drivers.explanation: Four of five vessels generated revenue: Safe Eurus and Safe Boreas were on hire the full period, and Safe Zephyrus and Safe Notos resumed operations after completing scheduled five-year surveys in April.
Company raised its full-year 2026 EBITDA guidance to the high end of the range it had previously communicated.
